hooks.name: AeroOps Quality Check
hooks.description: After saving a TypeScript source file under app/, components/, lib/, or tests/, run the project's existing type check, lint, and test commands and report the first failure.

action.command: echo "AeroOps quality check: type-check -> lint -> test" && echo "--- type-check (tsc --noEmit) ---" && npm run type-check && echo "--- lint (next lint) ---" && npm run lint && echo "--- test (vitest run) ---" && npm run test && echo "AeroOps quality check passed."
